correction.previous: M4150 main shaft assigned an extra5/32x1 split pin
correction.evidence: SNL134 M4165 pin assembly includes the split pin. SNL141 lists three total: two for .610x2-3/16 typeA pins, one for M4165. No M4150 assignment.
correction.decision: Remove unsupported main-shaft hole. Allocate SNL250 redundant split-pin mention to nested M4165, pending complete coverage reconciliation.

floor_frame_evidence: M180 rear channel riveted to M1937; M181 front channel to M1936, from SNL175/184. This does not prove the clutch bracket mounts on either engine channel. Current direct-floor mount is provisional.
alternatives: Selected development hypothesis: underside cap screws into bracket bosses through floor7
Unresolved alternative: attachment to engine frame or another structural receiver; revise bracket feet/holes when established

modern_taper_reference.limit: Modern product specification transfer; not proof of1928 internal tolerances/end form

source_review: Full original SNL37,63,134,136,141,142,193,200,201,204,242,280 and HB158/159 examined; original SNL2 clutch crop examined. Museum photographs inspected but mounting remains obscured. SNL250 reviewed in the parent packet.
